name: Page Watcher
tagline: Guards the web pages you name and speaks up only when a change matters.
description: Point it at any URL you keep checking by hand, whether a price, a restock, a listing or a new post, and it takes over the refreshing for you. Alerts stay rare by design: you hear about shifts that matter rather than every flicker of noise, and when a change deserves an answer it can draft the reply for your review.
author: teeRex247
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
